params.name: pages
params.description: Names of the most consulted pages.

params.name: hits
params.description: Number of hits for each page, synchronized index-for-index with pages.

params.name: usage
params.description: Percentage of the Web cache used.

overloads.semanticRole: The WEB GET STATISTICS command lets you get information about the most consulted pages loaded in the Web server’s cache.

constraints: Statistics only cover static pages, GIF/JPEG images under 100KB, and style sheets (.css) served from the Web server's cache.
